entries.task_id: suppose|they|were to toss both clean and unclean things on the earth
entries.description: Suppose they were to toss both clean and unclean things on the earth
entries.subject: Suppose
entries.object: were to toss both clean and unclean things on the earth

spans.text: Seyyathāpi, rāhula, pathaviyā sucimpi nikkhipanti, asucimpi nikkhipanti, gūthagatampi nikkhipanti, muttagatampi nikkhipanti, kheḷagatampi nikkhipanti, pubbagatampi nikkhipanti, lohitagatampi nikkhipanti, na ca tena pathavī aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā; Suppose they were to toss both clean and unclean things on the earth, like feces, urine, spit, pus, and blood.

Seyyathāpi, rāhula, āpasmiṁ sucimpi dhovanti, asucimpi dhovanti, gūthagatampi dhovanti, muttagatampi dhovanti, kheḷagatampi dhovanti, pubbagatampi dhovanti, lohitagatampi dhovanti, na ca tena āpo aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā; Suppose they were to wash both clean and unclean things in the water, like feces, urine, spit, pus, and blood.

entries.task_id: suppose|a|fire were to burn both clean and unclean things
entries.description: Suppose a fire were to burn both clean and unclean things
entries.subject: Suppose
entries.object: fire were to burn both clean and unclean things

spans.text: Seyyathāpi, rāhula, tejo sucimpi dahati, asucimpi dahati, gūthagatampi dahati, muttagatampi dahati, kheḷagatampi dahati, pubbagatampi dahati, lohitagatampi dahati, na ca tena tejo aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā; Suppose a fire were to burn both clean and unclean things, like feces, urine, spit, pus, and blood.
